It runs tool:leave-a-space and answers {"space":"sample-club","subject":"ana@example.com","left":false,"state":"none"}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Work out a member leaving a shared space and answer their member row marked left; what they put there stays", and give it space (The space's id, the last part of its record:space row id); subject (The person, the way the space and your access rules name them); records (The records the ask reads, as the caller read them from a store ({ id, type, value }): the space's record:space row, the member rows of the space (record:space-member), and, when a join row asks for access, the payment-event, record:commercial-offer, access-grant, access-effect-rule and effect-lifecycle rows.).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:leave-a-space and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Answers the person's record:space-member row marked left, stamped when, under `keep` for the caller to store.
